note: Notes for the command list (docs/command_list.md). Every move in the fighter's data shows up by itself; here, keyed by the ENGINE move name, you can add a display name, description, tags, a shown input, preview states, a group to merge into, or hide a move.

6C.name: Crescent Launcher
6C.desc: Launches. Any ground normal cancels into it. Jump (8) on hit to chase.

j.5C.name: j.C
j.5C.desc: Hold the button to charge it: the charged version bounces them off the floor.

Crossfire.desc: The first shot of her rekka. Shots cancel into a dash (66) on hit or block.

Crossfire: Finale.desc: Third part: a low finisher that knocks down.

Ricochet Prism.desc: Straight beam from the barrel. Follow up with B (hit or block).

Ricochet Prism: Burst.desc: 236B ~ B: she hops forward and fires a bigger beam that launches them away. Cancels into a super on hit.

Prism Overdrive.desc: Straight shots, then the big beam: it blasts them into a wall bounce.

Rising Comet.desc: Rising crescent kick (B: two kicks, invincible start: her anti-air). The follow-up only comes on hit, so it's very punishable on block.

Comet Burst.desc: Invincible. Two kicks send them very high; if both hit she rides her board up and slams them into the floor.

Fragment Kick.desc: She hops (A back, B forward) and kicks two red fragments that drift down and explode at the end of their path. Built for knockdown setups.

Fragment Kick EX.desc: Faster, harder-hitting fragments and a bigger blast.

Flux Dash.desc: A powered board dash straight through them (A short, B medium, C long). It only strikes if they're already in hitstun; otherwise she passes through. Once per jump.

Stardrive Cannon.desc: Huge sustained beam across the screen, invincible.

Crimson Waltz.desc: Board rush that passes through projectiles. On hit a flame prison floats them up while she circles it, firing into it, then it explodes.

Throw.desc: Close range. 4 + B+C throws behind you.

Air Throw.desc: Throw in the air, close range.
